fact: ISO's member register lists The Gambia Standards Bureau as a correspondent member of ISO, with participating and observing seats on technical committees the page does not name; the page carries no date, so its published date 2026-09-03 is used.

The bureau's 2022 catalogue of national standards lists GAMS ISO/IEC 27001:2005, on information security management systems, as a Gambian Standard adopted from ISO; the catalogue is dated 2022 on its cover.
